blocks.text: SANTIAGO CITY- President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday rolled out the Department of Education’s Kaagapay Program at the Patul Elementary School, saying his administration’s priorities will be on children’s health through feeding programs, among other services for public schools. Inspecting the Home-Grown School Feeding (HGSF) modality under the School-Based Feeding Program (SBFP) with Education Secretary Sonny Angara, President Marcos said he would further promote learners’ well-being through health initiatives.
